progression: The full-time English degree contains three 60 EC years. Ocasys dates the first three 10 EC courses in semester 1 and the remaining 30 EC in semester 2. The selected Stories We Live By option is open to Media Studies students. Some course descriptions are not yet published, so titles, credit and ordering follow the regulations and catalogue.

Use the Part B order of alternatives for this general example. Year two requires Introduction to Media Studies before Representations and Media Pasts, Presents and Futures before Networks and Platforms. Year-one Audiences and Uses and year-two Analyzing Media and Technology and Creative Destruction precede the Research Seminar. An admissible sequence places the two required year-two seminar prerequisites before the seminar. Future timetable details follow the later cohort catalogue. The 5 EC thematic group remains restricted choice.

Year three contains a 30 EC minor, 20 EC of advanced media work and a 10 EC thesis. The thesis requires all 60 first-year credits and at least 50 second-year credits, including Media and Power and the Research Seminar. Completing the first two years meets those conditions. The older catalogue course lists and transitional packages apply to earlier entrants.
